0.content:
Shenhe came from a branch family of the Mt. Tianheng exorcists. As a small child she was offered by her grief-maddened father to a malevolent god, and destroyed its remains herself. Cloud Retainer found her, persuaded her she was a friend, and raised her on Mt. Aocang. Her emotions are bound by red ropes. Shenhe learned from several adepti and is a master of the adeptal arts as a mortal. Cloud Retainer says that among all her pupils Shenhe most resembles herself, and that she would keep her by her side were Shenhe not mortal. Shenhe now lives in Liyue Harbor and works at Wanmin Restaurant.

In 2.4 Cloud Retainer sent her to the harbour with adeptal sigils for the new Jade Chamber, hoping she would reconnect with society, and introduced her to Ganyu. In 5.4 Shenhe spent more than three months' salary on a "Seniorjoy" tour for her master, calling her her "closest kin". Xianyun fretted over the expense, and Shenhe, misreading her, went to cancel it; the drunken organiser let slip that the tour was a scam, so she used her fists and broke it up, while Xianyun went to Mondstadt instead. Grateful neighbours thanked Xianyun for raising such a virtuous girl. She tries to influence Shenhe's decisions as little as possible.

1.content:
Ganyu, half-qilin secretary to the Qixing, trained with Cloud Retainer in the mountains as a girl. Cloud Retainer taught her how to cultivate health and nags her to rest and drink her Qingxin infusion. She has a habit of reminiscing about Ganyu's childhood in front of others, which makes Ganyu flee in embarrassment. In Ganyu's Story Quest (1.2) Cloud Retainer worried that a life in Jueyun Karst would not suit Ganyu's human side, and set her a challenge in the mountains.

In 4.4 Ganyu recognised her in human form at once and suggested she take a human name; Cloud Retainer chose "Xianyun"; Ganyu took it as a reference to the Full Record of Pristine Pavilion, whose lines about an adeptus who rises with the clouds and rests with the moon were written about Cloud Retainer herself. Ganyu says shopping with her takes all day because she inspects every item at every stall.

2.content:
Yuandai was a wild crane that gained wisdom and followed Cloud Retainer. She longed to be a heroine, so Cloud Retainer gave her a ten-year Human Mimicry Potion. Yuandai roamed Liyue as a nameless heroine, fell in love with an exorcist from Mt. Tianheng and stayed human past the limit, losing her memories. Cloud Retainer secretly kept her alive with teapills made with her own blood. In 4.4 Xianyun, the Traveler and Paimon met Yuandai and her granddaughter Shuyu at Wanmin Restaurant. Visits to Wangshu Inn, the villages north of Jueyun Karst and Qingyun Peak, and finally the Suspensus Somnium Mechanism, restored Yuandai's memory. She said farewell and became an ordinary crane again. The orphaned Shuyu asked to become Xianyun's disciple, and Xianyun made her the first disciple of her life in the human world.

Xianyun told Yuandai that an elder must let the young leave the nest, but that the door of home stays open to any who wish to return. Years earlier she had also carried the feverish young Shuyu to her abode and cured her, powdering herself white because the child insisted true adeptal cranes were white. Xianyun made Shuyu a new outfit, moved with her to Chihu Rock and introduced her to Ganyu and Shenhe over dinner.

3.comment: Xianyun: Rex Lapis and the Rite of Descension
3.content:
Cloud Retainer followed Morax in the Archon War, won over by his values and compassion; she says the adepti have guarded Liyue Harbor under him for 37 centuries. In Chapter I the Traveler reached her abode with a food offering and a Sigil of Permission to report that Rex Lapis had been assassinated. She flared her wings and proposed to "quash" Liyue Harbor before conferring with the others. The Traveler argued the offering made a contract, and she grudgingly agreed to investigate first. The adepti later learned Rex Lapis had retired and now lives as Zhongli; they accepted the Qixing's rule but reserved the right to intervene.

Zhongli now dines with her at Xinyue Kiosk and Liuli Pavilion, once sent her in his place to authenticate a book collector's ancient texts, and vouched for her antiques when she sold them to fund her move. Before the move he lectured her at length on home furnishing. He says he is "not well acquainted" with Xianyun, "but going by her name, she sounds like a good person", and notes with concern how readily she parts with Mora.

4.comment: Xianyun: Guizhong and the old gatherings
4.content: Guizhong, the God of Dust, was outgoing and loved gatherings and inventions. At her great stone table Sea Gazer flaunted treasures, Cloud Retainer and Guizhong countered with machines, and Marchosius ended every quarrel with his cooking. They drank on the heights until sunrise. Cloud Retainer once had Rex Lapis judge their inventions; he chose Guizhong's Obscuro Vulpes Mechanism. Guizhong died in the Archon War, and Cloud Retainer long avoided the place because it reminded her of those times. The stone table on Mt. Aocang still has seats carved "Here sits Retainer", "Here sits Guizhong" and "Here sits Rex".

5.comment: Xianyun: Mountain Shaper, Moon Carver and the mint
5.content:
Cloud Retainer's oldest surviving companions, whom she calls "those old fossils". They quarrel whenever they meet, yet she says the bond is so deep that she never feels alone. She suspects them of sneaking off to travel without her. During 4.4's limited Lantern Rite event they flew a Jade Chamber kite into her territory on Mt. Aocang in human disguises, and she played along to see how long they would keep up the act.

Mountain Shaper grows mint and wants to plant it around her abode, which she loathes. In 6.3 a Deadly Self possessed him and he planted mint at Mt. Aocang, vowing to rename it "Mt. Mint-cang". She banned both him and Moon Carver from the mountain for three days, because "one does not discriminate". In 7.1 he suggested she take up gardening and she shouted "Insolence!" Madame Ping says the three have bickered the same way for a century.

6.comment: Xianyun: Liyue Harbor life and money
6.content:
To fund life in the city Xianyun sold pieces from her collection to the antiques dealer Shaozu. Zhongli authenticated them, and Shaozu paid a deposit through the Northland Bank. She bought a house near Chihu Rock, by a miniature red-leaf tree at a confusing fork in the road. She is a familiar face to Fontainian machine sellers, Wanmin Restaurant (where she watches Guoba while waiting for noodles) and toy-seller Granny Shan.

Her Supreme Cuisine Machine is now several generations old, and she dreams of iterating it until it can cook every dish known to humankind. Friends old and new keep inviting her out, and she fears running short of Mora. She once asked Madame Ping how much it costs to live comfortably in the city.

7.comment: Xianyun: The Interlude Chapter and the Jade Chamber
7.content: In Chapter I (1.1) Cloud Retainer, Moon Carver and Mountain Shaper manned upgraded Guizhong Ballistae against Osial until the god smashed them; Ningguang then sank the Jade Chamber onto him. In the Interlude Chapter (2.4) she appeared to the Traveler, explained Shenhe's past, and said the adepti sensed a calamity coming. She had come to see whether Ningguang could uphold the contract between Liyue and its people; otherwise the adepti would take control. When Ningguang defeated Beisht with mortal forces, Cloud Retainer commended her preparations as real progress.

8.content: Xiao fought beside Cloud Retainer in the Archon War, when she spoke only to activate sigils. Meeting her human form at Wangshu Inn in 4.4, he nearly mentioned why she had taken human form some thirty years earlier, and she cut him off. She says he is even more withdrawn than she is and offers to make him tofu pudding. In 6.3 she declined his offer to fight Zizhi, judging that the time for armed confrontation had not come.

9.comment: Xianyun: Gaming and the Lantern Rite kites
9.content: Gaming met her resting by a lake, shared his food and called her a wise elder, and she resolved to look out for him. During the limited-time 4.4 Lantern Rite event she held a kite-making workshop on Mt. Aocang for her disciples, Yaoyao and Gaming. She commissioned festival outfits for Ganyu and Shenhe. Learning of Gaming's rift with his father Yip Tak, she staged a "bandit" ambush with Mountain Shaper and Moon Carver and arranged help from Zhongli and Charlotte to bring them together. At the festival, when the wind dropped, her adeptal arts sent a great kite of hers sweeping past to lift the falling kites back into the sky.
